name: Shiraishi Chika
source:
Riku's classmate.

She's good friends with Kaede and Kurumi, and the three of them can often be seen hanging out together.

She is the calmer of the three, and naturally chimes in as the voice of reason.

She gives off a somewhat sluggish aura.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.yuzu-soft.com/products/ten_sz/]official website[/url]]
